title: The Wonders of Pompeii
author: Marc Monnier

authorInfo.bio: Marc Monnier (1827–1885) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Wonders of Pompeii" by Marc Monnier is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work provides an engaging exploration of the ancient Roman city of Pompeii, focusing on its vibrant life before the catastrophic eruption of Mount Vesuvius.
